_meta.description: Fallback keyword lexicon for topic-evidence retrieval (Plan_Improve.md Sec 2.3b). Used to scan every Participant turn in the full real_interview (not just a tag-anchored one) for topic-relevant disclosures. Substrings are matched case-insensitively against the whole turn text, so a deliberately partial stem (e.g. 'concentrat') catches 'concentrate'/'concentrating'/'concentration'. Tuned by running scripts/audit_keyword_lexicon.py against the train split ONLY (Plan_Improve.md Sec 5.2) and reading the matched lines: bare single words that collided with unrelated speech were replaced with multi-word phrases or dropped. Known collisions fixed here: 'numb' (was matching inside 'number'/'numbers'), 'blue' (was matching the color, e.g. 'the blue hole in Belize'), 'down' (was matching 'downtown', 'lay down', 'somewhere down the line'), 'weight' (was matching 'lifting weights', 'height weight'), 'slow' (was matching 'work slow down', personality remarks), "can't think"/'hard to think' (idiomatic 'can't think of an example', not a concentration complaint), 'care about' (about caring for others, not anhedonia), bare 'guilt'/'guilty' (was matching legal 'not guilty of the crime' from unrelated life-history discussion).
